__note: LIBRARY MANIFEST — the per-library half of the whole code→canvas pipeline (docs/21). `ds-contracts promote --config <this>` runs the promote stage; `ds-contracts onboard --adopt examples/mui` runs capture → promote → emit → bundle → publish from it. packages/cli/src/promote.ts is the shared engine-free pipeline; nothing here is library-specific code.
__note:components: ORGANISM round + nested-instance (inputadornment/textfield) + Wave 5 denominator (all 15 pending families). Capture-dir names are lowercased importName; contractStem maps to kebab contract file stems.
__note:contractStem: The emitted Figma script is named kebab(contract.name), so a promoted contract FILE must carry the same stem or the compile receipt cannot find it. Capture-dir names come from the capture config; this is the one place the two spellings differ.
__note:authored: AUTHORED FACTS LEDGER — reviewed hand-authored facts the capture cannot carry (Fab/Avatar boxes, Accordion collapse clip, Link width drop — commit 16889547 had edited the promoted artifacts directly). promote.ts applies it after the computed contract and before the resolution guard, so the committed contracts + minted tree stay re-derivable; every row names its cause and a stale row refuses by name.
